elements.text: A factory reset erases all settings, ride history, and the display PIN. Use it only when a bike is being scrapped or when Atlas support asks for it.

When the owner's PIN is unavailable, an authorized dealer must check the owner's proof of purchase and set a new PIN with the dealer service tool. This keeps the ride history and settings without a factory reset. It does not unlock a bike reported as stolen.

Change the PIN from the settings menu during a service visit. The owner must enter the current PIN before choosing a new one. If the current PIN is unavailable, use the dealer recovery procedure instead.
